written: 2026-10-02T11:36:00+05:00, before any metric of this protocol was computed
evidence_status: development evidence: every measurement re-reads stored records of the ImageNet screen-1k list and the COCO screen-1k list; no model is run; nothing is measured on held-out images

inputs_read_only.matrix_readouts: artifacts/experiment_b2/matrix/cells/*.json -> readout_file (loaded through tools.analysis.b2_matrix.load_cells, which checks the readout sha256 and the shared row order)
inputs_read_only.detector: artifacts/experiment_b2_det/runs/1000/*.json -> detections/<configuration>-1000-<tag>.npz and bootstrap/<configuration>-1000-index.npz; FP32 = run record fp32--fp32; rows = tools.experiment_b.common.dataset('coco_screen_1k') (1,000 rows); annotations through tools.experiment_b2_det.stats.annotations()
inputs_read_only.never_read: the ImageNet 10k list file, the COCO 5k list file, artifacts/per_image_predictions/*val5k*, any dataset yaml val entry; no image folder is listed

fp32_reference: the FP32 record of the same network on the same ordered 1k rows: matrix baseline cell (matrix cells and sweep rows, ResNet18), evals/<model>/fp32.npz (AdaRound arms); the FP32 argmax c0 must be unique on every image (checked; abort otherwise)

part_A_classifier_agreement.units: every matrix cell (150 matrix + 24 intrinsic-arm cells), every AdaRound arm, every accumulator-sweep policy row at 1,000 images; each against FP32 of the same network
part_A_classifier_agreement.tie_set: T = set of classes sharing the largest quantized logit, k = |T| = tie_size. Matrix: known exactly when k <= 5 (first k entries of top5_lowest); when k > 5, c0 in T if c0 is in top5_lowest, c0 not in T if c0 < top5_lowest[4] and not listed, otherwise undetermined. AdaRound: known exactly when k <= 5 (first k entries of top5_topk, as a set); otherwise c0 in T if listed, else undetermined. Sweep: top1_tied_classes stores T exactly.

metrics.agreement_lowest_index: 1[min(T) == c0]. Exact for matrix (argmax_lowest) and sweep (top5[0]); AdaRound exact when k <= 5, else undetermined (bounds 0/1).
metrics.agreement_expected: 1[c0 in T]/k (probability that a uniformly random tie break returns c0). Bounds [lower, upper] with undetermined images contributing 0 and 1/k; the count of undetermined images is reported; a cell with undetermined images is reported with both bounds and excluded from interval-based comparisons of agreement.
metrics.agreement_topk: 1[top5_topk[0] == c0], the stored CUDA topk order (matrix, AdaRound; secondary, tie order unspecified).
metrics.flips: lowest-index correctness against FP32 correctness: correct_to_wrong, wrong_to_correct counts; expected-credit analogue: sum over images of max(0, c_fp32 - c_q) and max(0, c_q - c_fp32) with c = expected credit.
metrics.top5_overlap: mean |top5_q intersect top5_fp32| / 5 with top5_q = top5_lowest (matrix), top5 (sweep), top5_topk (AdaRound, stored order); plus the share of images whose FP32 top-1 is in top5_q.
metrics.error_overlap: for every pair of units of one model and one recipe group (matrix default, matrix minimal, intrinsic arms with their recipe, AdaRound arms, sweep policies of one case): Jaccard of the lowest-index error sets and the phi correlation of the error indicators; reported for pairs where both units have top-1 above 10 percent.
metrics.mcnemar: exact McNemar (tools.analysis.b_stage_balanced_comparisons.paired_outcomes): each unit against FP32 on lowest-index correctness; each format pair on lowest-index correctness and on lowest-index agreement with FP32.

part_A_classifier_agreement.resolution_comparison: for every pair of formats of one model and one recipe (matrix default and minimal, each format's own cell; both top-1 >= 10 percent and no undetermined agreement image): top-1 difference on expected credit and agreement difference on expected agreement, each with the pointwise 95 percent paired image bootstrap (tools.analysis.b2_matrix.interval = b2_ties.paired, 10,000 resamples, seed 20260927), and the exact McNemar p on the lowest-index versions. Counts of pairs resolved (interval excludes 0) by top-1 only, by agreement only, by both, by neither; ratio of interval widths; sign concordance of the two differences. Agreement and top-1 are different estimands: agreement resolves closeness to FP32, not accuracy; this is stated with every count.

part_B_resolution_power.contrasts: classifier: every matrix cell against FP32 and against INT8 of the same recipe, every format pair of resolution_comparison; detector: the nine sentinels under default and conformant against FP32, conformant minus default per format
part_B_resolution_power.subsamples: n in {128, 256, 512, 1000}; R = 50 random permutations of the 1,000 rows (numpy default_rng(20261002 + r)); each permutation split into floor(1000/n) disjoint blocks of n; per block the paired difference, the analytic paired SE sqrt((p_d - d^2)/n) (binary) or SD of per-image differences / sqrt(n) (expected credit), and the 95 percent percentile interval width (binary: paired_outcomes multinomial scheme, 10,000 resamples; expected credit: 2,000-resample image bootstrap). Summary per n: median width, between-block SD of the difference where >= 3 blocks, and the slope of log width against log n (expected -0.5).
part_B_resolution_power.detector_subsamples: AP (mAP50-95, mAP50) difference per block with COCOeval accumulate restricted to the block (tools.experiment_b2_det.stats.Evaluated.metrics) and a 500-draw paired bootstrap within the block; R = 3 permutations for n in {128, 256, 512}; n = 1000 uses the stored 2,000-draw bootstrap vectors; contrasts: INT8 default, INT8 conformant, INT6 default, FP8 E4M3 default, Posit8 default against FP32, and INT8 conformant minus default.
part_B_resolution_power.coverage_simulation: paired binary outcomes (left-only, right-only, both-same) drawn i.i.d. from multinomial(n, p) with p set to observed (left-only, right-only) rates: the 25 quantile scenarios of the observed discordance over matrix contrasts against FP32 and against INT8 (discordance quantiles 5,25,50,75,95 percent x asymmetry quantiles 5,25,50,75,95 percent), plus the null scenarios p01 = p10 at total discordance 1, 2, 5, 10, 20 percent. n in {128, 256, 512, 1000}; S = 2,000 simulated data sets per scenario and n; B = 2,000 bootstrap draws per data set (the multinomial scheme of paired_outcomes); intervals: percentile, BCa (z0 = Phi^-1((#{theta* < theta_hat} + 0.5 #{theta* = theta_hat}) / B), acceleration from the closed-form jackknife of the paired difference), and the Wald reference d +- 1.96 sqrt((p_d - d^2)/n). Coverage = share containing the true p01 - p10; Monte Carlo SE reported. Seed 20261002.
part_B_resolution_power.minimum_detectable_difference: two-sided alpha 0.05, power 0.8, paired binary outcomes: MDD(n, p_d) = (z_0.975 + z_0.8) sqrt(p_d / n) (normal approximation), checked by simulation with the exact McNemar test at the median observed discordance (S = 4,000 per point); for equivalence (TOST, true difference 0, margin delta): n = (z_0.95 + z_0.9)^2 p_d / delta^2. Detector: MDD = 2.80 x SE_AP(n) with SE_AP from the bootstrap.
part_B_resolution_power.projections: projection only, no measurement: interval half-width at N = 9,000 (sealed ImageNet remainder of the 10k list) and N = 4,000 (sealed COCO complement) = half-width_1k x sqrt(1000/N), using the measured log-width slope as a check of the sqrt scaling; ImageNet 9k is 9 images per class, so class stratification is noted but not modelled.
part_B_resolution_power.recommendations: per hypothesis type (sign reversal beyond delta, equivalence within delta, non-inferiority of a narrow accumulator against its wide arm, detector difference): recommended margin and image count, labelled as recommendations; compute ledger from per-run costs stated in the lane documents and surveys (matrix cell, exact engine per image, detector arm, COCOeval bootstrap CPU), with the source of each rate.

part_C_ties.classifier: per matrix cell: expected-credit minus lowest-index top-1 (pp), and the SD of top-1 under one uniformly random tie break, 100 sqrt(sum over label-tied images (1/k)(1 - 1/k)) / n; summarised per format family and bit width (median, interquartile range, max) for cells with top-1 >= 10 percent; the same for AdaRound arms (expected from label_among_maxima / tie_size) and sweep rows.
part_C_ties.detector_cross_image: stored fixed-rule detections, image-local COCO matching held fixed (COCOeval.evaluate once): (i) random evaluation-image order, R = 200 permutations (seed 20261002): equal scores across images are ordered by image position, within an image by emission order, as pycocotools does; (ii) uniformly random order among all equal-score detections of a category (R = 200). Our accumulate must reproduce COCOeval's mAP50-95 and mAP50 of the stored order to 1e-12 before any order is drawn. Reported: mean (expected AP), SD, 2.5/97.5 percentiles, the fixed-rule value and its percentile rank, for the nine sentinels under default and conformant (nearest available for block formats) and FP32. Verdict re-check: INT8 default exit (within 1 point of FP32), conformant minus default per format, sentinel ordering, under the expected AP.
part_C_ties.detector_within_image: optional GPU part through tools/experiment_b2_det/tieorders.py: not planned in v1 (stated as not run unless an addendum is written).
part_C_ties.rule_recommendation: written after the numbers, labelled as a recommendation: which rule is primary and how the other is reported

part_D_detector_agreement.units: the nine sentinels under default and conformant (nearest available for block formats), plus int6/int8 default_head_logits, against FP32 (fp32--fp32, fixed rule)
part_D_detector_agreement.matching: pycocotools COCOeval on the 1k screen subset (tools ... resampled_coco order = ascending sha256 rows, the fixed rule), area 'all', maxDets 100; FP32 true positive at IoU t = a ground-truth object matched by an FP32 detection at threshold t; kept = matched also by the quantized configuration at t; t in {0.5, 0.75}; at all scores and at score >= 0.25
part_D_detector_agreement.false_positives: at score >= 0.25 and IoU 0.5: quantized false positives (unmatched, not ignored) and new false positives = those with no FP32 detection of the same category at score >= 0.25 overlapping at IoU >= 0.5
part_D_detector_agreement.box_drift: for objects matched by both at IoU 0.5 (score >= 0.25): IoU between the two matched boxes (median, mean) and mean change of IoU to the ground truth
part_D_detector_agreement.score_rank: quantized detections matched to FP32 detections greedily (same image and category, IoU >= 0.5, descending FP32 score, score >= 0.25 on FP32): Spearman correlation of scores (average ranks) pooled, and the share of matched pairs whose FP32 order is reversed (Kendall discordance)
part_D_detector_agreement.ap_by_area: full COCOeval (area ranges small, medium, large; maxDets 1/10/100) on the 1k subset; mAP50-95 must equal the stored run record value to 1e-9; point estimates; paired 500-draw bootstrap for INT8 and INT6 default against FP32
part_D_detector_agreement.score_quantisation_step: INT6 and INT8: default (k-bit sigmoid scores, DFL and projection codes) against default_head_logits (all three wide); CPU approximation of the score step alone: the stored default_head_logits detections with scores re-quantised onto the score code grid inferred from the stored default detections (unit = greatest common grid of the distinct stored scores), code 0 dropped (below the 0.001 threshold), image order and boxes unchanged; reported as an approximation (NMS ran on wide scores).

part_E_fixed_accumulator_width.source: results/summaries/accumulator-sweep-v1/policies.csv and widths.csv; per-image scores from the sweep predictions
part_E_fixed_accumulator_width.type: uniform signed saturating register sat.w<W> only (one accumulator type), W = 16..32; the eight ResNet18 B2 cases (int8, int8 signed, int6, fp6_e2m3, fp7_e3m3, fp8_e4m3fn, posit8_es1, fp8_e5m2); float accumulators (fp16 rule, f21) are a separate type and reported separately
part_E_fixed_accumulator_width.fill_rule: measured at 1,000 images where measured; W >= W_noevent (no event on 1,000 images) = the exact arm by definition; W below the narrowest measured width = 'collapsed, not measured' with the narrowest measured value as context (monotone extrapolation, labelled)
part_E_fixed_accumulator_width.keeps_accuracy: top-1 expected credit within 1 pp of the case's own wide arm (point estimate), and the paired interval reported; absolute top-1 also reported
part_E_fixed_accumulator_width.order: format order by top-1 expected at each W; paired differences between formats at the same W (b2_ties.paired) where both have per-image data; Kendall tau of the order between adjacent widths

multiplicity: none; every interval is pointwise and descriptive
compute: CPU only, at most 6 busy processes, nice -n 10; no GPU job in v1
outputs: results/summaries/quality-metrics-v1/ (written once), results/figures/quality-metrics-*, docs/analysis/quality-metrics-resolution-2026-10-02.md; working files under artifacts/quality_metrics_v1/
